roleFamilies.reason: Immediately after Walker's injury, Atlanta reported that Thomas and Dorlus were among the primary players rotating in Walker's main left-edge spot, while Ebukam remained part of the pass-rush mix. The current Falcons depth chart lists Thomas first at one defensive-end position, Dorlus first at the other and Ebukam behind Dorlus.

Atlanta explicitly cross-trained Daniels and Perkins in Walker's left-edge spot after the injury while they also worked in the inside-linebacker rotation, matching the off-ball/coverage/blitz multiplicity Walker was expected to provide.

baselineRoleCaveats.reason: Dorlus already carries an independent front role. If he shifts snaps to Walker's edge responsibilities, the role he vacates must be backfilled before his full value can be credited as pure replacement value.

Atlanta reported Ebukam was primarily working off the right side opposite Walker before the injury. A left-side shift can create a vacated-role cascade, so his full value is an upper-bound replacement credit only, not an exact credit.
Deablo is a current first-team inside linebacker and an existing baseline contributor; do not credit his full value again merely because Walker's off-ball work is redistributed.
Harris is a current first-team inside linebacker and existing baseline contributor; do not credit his full value again without distinct incremental replacement evidence.

separateUnavailablePlayers.rule: Keep Pearce separate from Walker. His unavailability may alter the edge environment but must be handled by its own governed personnel event before any numeric combination.

A zero opponent-specific increment is therefore the only defensible shadow matchup decision at this stage.
